_comment: OPTIONAL hooks registration to merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope), next to the permissions block from settings.json. Copy the hooks key into your settings.json. Use ABSOLUTE paths: the scripts live in ~/.claude/hooks, not in the project (so ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} does not point at them), and some builds do not expand $HOME/%USERPROFILE% inside hook commands. Replace the ABSOLUTE_HOME placeholder with your real home path (e.g. /home/you or C:/Users/you). guard = recommended security hook; its matcher covers Bash, PowerShell (a separate tool on Windows that Bash rules and a Bash-only matcher miss) and Monitor, plus Write/Edit for the fix-once files and generated agents. format/verify = convenience (allowlist-gated) — delete the blocks you do not want. verify blocks finishing at most CLAUDE_VERIFY_MAX_BLOCKS times in a row (default 3), then shows a still-RED warning. verify is registered twice, same script: Stop runs the checks; UserPromptSubmit only records a turn-start marker - the working-tree state verify last checked, or the current tree on a session's first prompt (no checks, no output, always exit 0) - so a turn in which nothing changed since the last check (e.g. a review in an already-red project) is never blocked, while files written in between (e.g. by a background subagent) are still checked — drop that entry and verify behaves as before (Stop only). WINDOWS: use the .ps1 scripts. Shell-form commands run through Git Bash, or PowerShell when Git Bash is missing (never cmd), so prefer exec form, which spawns powershell.exe directly with no shell and no nested quoting: { "type": "command", "command": "powershell.exe", "args": ["-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", "C:/Users/you/.claude/hooks/guard.ps1"] } — same pattern for format.ps1 and verify.ps1 (verify.ps1 in both its UserPromptSubmit and its Stop entry). The shell-form equivalent is: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\you\.claude\hooks\guard.ps1". The _optional_perPromptDelegationReminder key below is documentation only; if you want it, append its UserPromptSubmit entry to the hooks.UserPromptSubmit array (keep verify's entry there).

_optional_perPromptDelegationReminder._comment: OPT-IN, documentation only. The base plugin's per-prompt auto-delegation reminder from before base 1.6.0, verbatim. Base 1.6.0 replaced it with one SessionStart line (startup, clear, compact). To get the per-prompt reminder back as well, add this UserPromptSubmit entry to the hooks.UserPromptSubmit array of ~/.claude/settings.json (next to verify's entry if you use verify). It fires on every prompt and adds its text to context each time, so it costs tokens on every turn. Shell form: the single-quoted echo needs sh or Git Bash.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Standing directive: for substantive tasks, proactively delegate to subagents (Agent tool) or a Workflow and auto-invoke any relevant skill; do not wait to be asked. Scale to task size: answer trivial or conversational prompts inline with no delegation. Prefer parallel subagents for multi-part or multi-file work; verify findings before finalizing."}}'
